mapper.select: select r.return_id,r.tenant_id,r.dept_id,r.purchase_id,po.purchase_no,r.original_period_id,r.return_period_id,r.return_no,r.return_date,r.customer_type,r.member_id,r.customer_name,r.customer_phone,r.refund_amount,r.refunded_amount,r.status,r.reason,r.remark,r.version, coalesce((select sum(pi.purchase_quantity) from mem_purchase_item pi where pi.purchase_id=r.purchase_id and pi.tenant_id=r.tenant_id and pi.dept_id=r.dept_id), 0) as purchase_quantity, (select sum(ri.return_total_quantity) from mem_purchase_return_item ri where ri.return_id=r.return_id and ri.tenant_id=r.tenant_id and ri.dept_id=r.dept_id) as total_return_quantity from mem_purchase_return r left join mem_purchase_order po on po.purchase_id=r.purchase_id and po.tenant_id=r.tenant_id and po.dept_id=r.dept_id left join mem_member m on m.member_id=r.member_id and m.tenant_id=r.tenant_id and m.dept_id=r.dept_id and m.del_flag='0' where r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and r.dept_id=#{deptId} and r.del_flag='0' and r.purchase_id=#{purchaseId} and r.status=#{status} and ( r.customer_name like concat('%', #{memberKeyword}, '%') or r.customer_phone like concat('%', #{memberKeyword}, '%') or m.member_name like concat('%', #{memberKeyword}, '%') or m.member_no like concat('%', #{memberKeyword}, '%') or m.phone like concat('%', #{memberKeyword}, '%') ) order by r.return_id desc

select r.return_id,r.tenant_id,r.dept_id,r.purchase_id,po.purchase_no,r.original_period_id,r.return_period_id,r.return_no,r.return_date,r.customer_type,r.member_id,r.customer_name,r.customer_phone,r.refund_amount,r.refunded_amount,r.status,r.reason,r.remark,r.version from mem_purchase_return r left join mem_purchase_order po on po.purchase_id=r.purchase_id and po.tenant_id=r.tenant_id and po.dept_id=r.dept_id where r.return_id=#{returnId} and r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and r.dept_id=#{deptId} and r.del_flag='0'
select * from mem_purchase_return_item where return_id=#{returnId} and tenant_id=#{tenantId} and dept_id=#{deptId} order by return_item_id

select item_id, sum(return_sale_quantity) as return_sale_quantity, sum(return_gift_quantity) as return_gift_quantity from mem_purchase_return join mem_purchase_return_item using (return_id, tenant_id, dept_id) where mem_purchase_return.purchase_id=#{purchaseId} and mem_purchase_return.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and mem_purchase_return.dept_id=#{deptId} and mem_purchase_return.del_flag='0' and mem_purchase_return.status not in ('CANCELLED') group by item_id
select coalesce(sum(refund_amount), 0) from mem_purchase_return where purchase_id=#{purchaseId} and tenant_id=#{tenantId} and dept_id=#{deptId} and del_flag='0' and status not in ('CANCELLED')
mapper.delete: delete from mem_purchase_return_item where return_id=#{returnId} and tenant_id=#{tenantId} and dept_id=#{deptId}
mapper.select: select return_id,tenant_id,dept_id,purchase_id,original_period_id,return_period_id,return_no,return_date,customer_type,member_id,customer_name,customer_phone,refund_amount,refunded_amount,status,reason,remark,version from mem_purchase_return where return_id=#{returnId} and tenant_id=#{tenantId} and dept_id=#{deptId} and del_flag='0' for update
